stats.title: The Most Elegant Haircuts for Every Hair Type

structure.what_is_said: You might think the key to an elegant look lies in the perfect outfit. But here's the truth. Your haircut holds just as much power to transform your presence. (same wording as the Hairstyles video, 'hairstyle' -> 'haircut')
how_it_is_shown: 3.7-5.5 clip washes to cream with 'Here's the truth.' script
5.5-10.0 CREAM/WHITE+picture: same face twice, side by side

structure.what_is_said: In today's video, we're revealing the most elegant haircuts of 2026. Timeless shapes that complement every hair type. And the best part,
we'll guide you on how to style each one with ease. So, let's get started, everyone.
how_it_is_shown: FULL salon clip + 'Episode 15 / Elegant Haircuts' title (script)

structure.what_is_said: Let's start with a look that has quietly become a signature of modern elegance, curtain bangs.

Quiet luxury; soft, flattering, timeless; works on fine, thick, straight, wavy, curly, coily hair; low maintenance; how to style (dampen, round brush over/under, alternate left/right, lift root, bump ends); many ways to wear; closing quote.
how_it_is_shown: strip of 5 small rounded photos built on hair-type words (44.5-52.9)
rows with tall centre tutorial + side framed photos (60-80)
ROW 3 + strip of 4 for 'ways to wear'

structure.what_is_said: Next, we have a haircut that has truly stood the test of time, the signature bob.

Quietly powerful; shorter Parisian vs longer old-money; what to ask your stylist for each length; adapts to fine and thick hair; closing line on finish; styling (flat iron, jumbo rollers, brush); can be worn half up, updos, parted, curled.
how_it_is_shown: CREAM split 'Ask your stylist for:' x2 (135.4-148.4)

structure.what_is_said: Next, we have a cut that truly flatters everyone. Long layers.
how_it_is_shown: white blank then WHITE/CARD '3. Long Layers'

structure.what_is_said: Timeless because of movement; softness, flow, dimension; what to ask your stylist; adapts smooth, blowout or natural; works down, half up, French twist, low bun, ponytail; Hollywood waves sub-style with history and steps.
how_it_is_shown: strip of 7 small photos built on style words 248.3-261.2
FULL Marilyn archival footage + 'Hollywood Waves' script 261.2-267

structure.what_is_said: Here's a secret most elegant women never share: they know what flatters them (hairstyles for face shape, silhouettes, colors); if you'd like to discover yours, access our personal stylist guide in the description, sent instantly to your email.
how_it_is_shown: cream + centre creator clips incl. before/after captions
FULL fashion clip with 'Check The Description / Personal Stylist Guide' 320-332.2

structure.what_is_said: Moving on to one of the most captivating cuts of all time, and one of my personal favorites, the pixie.

Confident, refined, feminine; draws attention to eyes, cheekbones, neck; worn by Audrey Hepburn, Halle Berry, Alana de la Garza; the bixie; delicacy; fine/thick/textured hair; quote; what to ask your hairstylist.
how_it_is_shown: ROW 3 builds (named women added on names 361.5-367.9)
caramel split quote with Audrey still

structure.what_is_said: Now, let's talk about full bangs. There is something undeniably iconic about a woman in full bangs.
European, artistic, confident; frame the face; adapts to straight, waves, curly/coily; carries confidence; pairs with minimal makeup and jewelry; closing quote.
how_it_is_shown: strip building to 10 photos held 10 s

structure.what_is_said: There are so many more elegant haircuts we'd love to share with you. So, let us know in the comments if you'd like a part two.
how_it_is_shown: FULL salon bangs clip, no text

structure.what_is_said: Thank you so much for spending your time with us today. We truly hope you found this video helpful and made you feel inspired. A simple like or comment would truly mean the world to us here at Classy Academy.

And if you'd like to discover the hairstyles, clothing, and colors that flatter you best, and always have a timeless style and elegance guide to browse from, you can access our personal stylist guide in the description. We've also linked our favorite hair tools and products below.
Until next time, bye my loves.

how_it_is_shown: WHITE/CARD tan CA logo, music swell and fade

tricks: HOOK (Q1): same script template as the Hairstyles video, word for word ('hairstyle' -> 'haircut'). 0-3.7 bangs woman with flowers; 3.7-5.5 a clip washes to cream while 'Here's the truth.' writes on (the only hook text); 5.5-10 one face twice on cream. 'In Today's Video...' card 10-12.2; 3 quick FULL clips 12.2-19 (bob, hair flip, pixie: three different haircuts in 7 s); title 'Episode 15 / Elegant Haircuts' 19-23.4. First numbered card at 0:23.6.

Point opening (Q2): the numbered white script card comes FIRST and stays up while the lead-in sentence is spoken (card 4.5-6.6 s; the name is said at the end: 'curtain bangs' 27.5, 'signature bob' 109, 'the pixie' 338). Then dissolve to caramel/cream and a hero clip (FULL or caramel+centre).

Point closing (Q2): every point ends on a written line: a quote card that repeats the spoken sentence (Curtain Bangs 100.3-105.3; bob mid-point 161-166.4; pixie 402-410.7; full bangs 491.7-497.4) or an 'Ask your stylist for:' split (bob 135-148, long layers 221-230, pixie 412-419). Hollywood waves inside point 3 ends on a row (295-301).

Haircut-specific device: 'Ask your stylist for:' cream split screen - rounded photo left, script heading + quoted serif request right, typed on while the voice says the exact salon words. Used 4 times (2:19, 2:24, 3:41, 6:52). This replaces the long tutorials of the hairstyles video.

Tutorial hold (Q3): much shorter than in the Hairstyles video: bob styling 15 s (166.4-181.4, caramel+centre), Hollywood waves 22 s (273.3-295.4, rounded clip on white, same creator as @fayequeenan in the 2025 video), full-bangs styling demos 7 s (438.6-445.9) and 9 s (470.3-479.5), curtain-bangs round-brush clip ~13 s spread across rows with side photos (64.3-79.8). Creator's own cuts only.
Other holds (Q3): FULL clips 1-6.5 s (pixie hero 6.2 s, street bangs 6.5 s); caramel+centre clips 2-5 s; empty caramel/cream breaths 0.5-3.6 s (185.4-189 is the longest, before 'you won't').

Rows (Q4): 3 panels built one per beat (~1 s apart), different women, mixed ages (40-50 at 33.7, 60+ at 88, 50-60 at 123, 55-65 at 235, 50-60 at 270) and skin tones. NEW vs 2025: (a) strips of 5-10 small photos that build one photo per spoken hair type/style: 44.5-52.9 (fine, thick, straight, waves, curly/coily), 248.3-261.2 (down, half up, French twist, low bun, ponytail - 7 photos), 386.5-398.7 (two strips of 5), 453.5-470.3 (to 10 photos, held 10 s); (b) rounded-corner frames on caramel and cream; (c) tall centre clip with smaller framed photos on each side (60-80, 369).

Small text (Q5): no channel creator credits at all; only watermarks left inside source clips ('@CREWHAIRSTUDIO' 41.9, 'TikTok @melisekrem' 193.9, TikTok logo 470). No tip notes. Channel text is only cards, quotes, 'Ask your stylist for:' and guide call-outs.

Named women (Q6): names are spoken once in a list and each photo is ADDED TO THE ROW exactly on her name: Audrey Hepburn 361.5, Halle Berry 362.1, Alana de la Garza 363.5 - photos, not film, no name labels. Audrey Hepburn also appears unnamed as a film scene (379.1-384.8), as a rounded still next to the pixie quote (402-410.7) and in B&W at the thank-you (502-505). Unnamed: Kate Middleton (appears to be) 215.1 and possibly 85.5 (unclear), 242.5, 295.4; Marilyn Monroe archival footage 261.2-267 under 'golden age of cinema' with 'Hollywood Waves' script; Princess Diana 375.2; Monica Bellucci film 204.7 and 221.2 - all judged by eye.

Do/don't, before/after (Q7): no ticks/crosses. Hook shows one face twice. The only before/after in the body is a creator's own clip with her captions 'Me before:...' / 'Vs. after learning what flatters me' (310-314.9) inside the guide segment. 'Not choppiness' / 'rather than overly thinned' are said, not shown as don'ts.

Guide mention (Q8): mid-video between point 3 and point 4 (301.3-332.2), opened like a point with a script card 'Here's a secret...', then 'Check The Description' + 'Personal Stylist Guide' over a glamorous fashion clip for ~12 s while the benefits are listed and 'sent instantly to your email'. Repeated at the end (514.9-533.1) with 'Classy Lady Guides' and a second link 'Hairtools and Products'. Comment ask 497.4-501 ('let us know in the comments if you'd like a part two') and like/comment ask 509-514 ('mean the world to us here at Classy Academy'), no text.

Ending (Q9): last 30 s = 510-540: garden clip -> sunglasses close-ups -> bob blow-dry -> 'Classy Lady Guides' clips -> 'Hairtools and Products' colonnade clip -> 'bye my loves' as it dissolves to the white CA end card (533.1); music swells to about -16/-17 dB (louder than the voice) for ~3 s, steps down, fades to silence by 540.

Haircut points use the 'proof by hair type' line in EVERY point (curtain bangs 44-52, bob 150-161, long layers 235-247, pixie 386-399, full bangs 453-470), each time shown with a strip or row in the order of the words.
Sub-style inside a point (Hollywood waves in long layers): archival icon footage + white script sub-title, then a row, then the tutorial - no numbered card.

Reuse: several clips are shared with the 2025 Hairstyles video (salon/stylist clip 19-23.4 = A 48-50; shutters woman 38.5 = A 13.2; sea woman 479.5 = A 16.7; Hollywood waves tutorial 273.3 = A 205.1).
Copy-worthy (Q10): cream (#F8F3F0-like) is used for 'teaching' screens (ask-your-stylist, secret, before/after) while pure white is kept for numbered cards; caramel for quotes and B-roll.

Pattern: the body is built from 1-second photo pops (rows and strips) synced to listed words, which keeps the picture changing even without a long tutorial; the slow stretches are the cards (4.5-6.6 s), the quote/ask-your-stylist screens (4-9 s) and the guide clip (12 s).
